title: Karnataka hospital medicines: annual indent versus actual supply
summary: Compares Karnataka's 2025-26 annual medicine indent with KSMSCL tenders, purchase orders, hospital supply records and payments, to identify quantity or value gaps that citizens can follow up through public records.
jurisdiction: Karnataka, India — State government hospitals and KSMSCL
authority: Karnataka State Medical Supplies Corporation Ltd (KSMSCL), Department of Health and Family Welfare
scope: Drug-wise annual indent quantities and procurement mode for 2025-26.
Tendered, awarded and supplied quantities for the same drugs.
Unexplained gaps between indent, purchase orders, hospital receipts and payments.
Whether purchases follow Karnataka's public procurement rules.
out_of_scope: Private individuals, patients or clinical decisions
statutory_anchors: Karnataka Transparency in Public Procurements Act, 1999
Karnataka Transparency in Public Procurements Rules, 2000

sources.name: Annual Indent 2025-26 — 890 Drugs
sources.publisher: Karnataka State Medical Supplies Corporation Ltd

sources.name: Report No. 8 of 2024 — Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services, Government of Karnataka
sources.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
